body.x: Parrot unveiled 'Airborne Night Drone' at the ‘CES Unveiled Las Vegas 2016.’ CES Unveiled is an event only for media, held in Las Vegas, U.S. on January 4th, to show more than 100 companies’ technology and products in advance.Airborne Night Drone can flight safely and quickly with its bright white LED in the dark place.
